description: This file is a shell script that manages the DHCPv6 client service on a device. It includes functions for starting, stopping, updating, and configuring the DHCPv6 client, as well as setting up event handlers for system events related to network and IPv6 status updates.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes system configurations and retrieves network and IPv6 states from system variables and sysevents.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the DHCPv6 client service if certain conditions are met, such as the correct router mode and link status.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the DHCPv6 client service by killing the process and removing its PID file.

methods.name: service_update
methods.description: Updates the DHCPv6 client state based on current configuration. Starts or stops the service accordingly.

methods.name: register_dhcpv6_client_handler
methods.description: Registers system event handlers to trigger the DHCPv6 client script on specific network events.

methods.name: unregister_dhcpv6_client_handler
methods.description: Unregisters system event handlers for DHCPv6 client events.

methods.name: service_enable
methods.description: Enables the DHCPv6 client service and initiates a start.

methods.name: service_disable
methods.description: Disables the DHCPv6 client service and initiates a stop.
